title.full: What to do about a suspected ICA scam call

summary.text: Ignore the call, do not share personal details, and report suspected fraud to Police.

details.heading: Get scam-related advice
details.body: Call the anti-scam centre at 1800-722-6688 for scam-related advice.

steps.name: Ignore the call
steps.text: If you have reason to believe the call is a scam, ignore it and the caller’s instructions.

items: If you have reason to believe that the call is a scam, ignore it and the caller’s instructions.

steps.name: Keep your details private
steps.text: Do not provide personal information, including your identification or banking details.

items: Do not provide personal information such as your name, identification number, passport details, contact details, or banking and credit card details.

steps.name: Report suspected fraud
steps.text: Report it to Police if you suspect any fraudulent act or wrongdoing.

items: Report to Police if you suspect any fraudulent act or wrongdoing.

If you have reason to believe that the call is a scam, you are advised to take the following precautions: Ignore such calls and the caller’s instructions
Do not provide personal information such as your name, identification number, passport details, contact details, or banking and credit card details
Report to Police if you suspect any fraudulent act or wrongdoing.
Members of the public can seek scam-related advice by calling the anti-scam centre at 1800-722-6688
